title: Open session
description: One open execution episode of one worker, .ai/local/state/sessions-open/<provider session>.yaml, with .ai/local/state/session-current.yaml pointing at the episode of this checkout; identity fields computed from git.

provider.description: The provider whose lifecycle event opened the episode. Only something running inside that provider's own hook can supply it.

provider_session.description: That provider's own session identity: the string the prompt archive stamps on the same worker's records, and the name this episode's file is keyed by. One episode per provider session.
